shortDescription: Australia's Ingenia Communities ASX:INA said on Wednesday it has received an improved offer from private equity firm Warburg Pincus, its fourth bid, valuing the firm at A$2.24 billion  ($1.55 billion).($1 = 1.4229 Australian dollars)
